title: Clock-Enable Register
statement: Create an 8-bit register with a clock-enable signal that updates its output only when enable is high on a clock edge. When enable is low, the output remains unchanged. A synchronous reset should clear the register to zero.
module_signature: module clock_enable_register(input clk, input rst, input en, input [7:0] d, output reg [7:0] q);
behavior: If en is 1 on the rising edge, q <= d.
If en is 0, q holds its value.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous reset or latches in the implementation.
hint: A single clocked always block with conditional enable is enough.
